# case: normal; retain precision in the returned index
import numpy as np
def _accurate_index(value):
    return int(np.isfinite(value) and
               abs(value - (-0.24066933384569345)) <= 1e-12)
assert np.allclose(_accurate_index(compute_truncation_gap_index(4, 3, 0.8, 1.2)), target)
